name: Lumen Climber
summary:
Lumen Climber is a fast-paced endless arcade game set in a glowing neon cosmos. Jump from platform to platform, climb as high as possible, and collect the active bombs in the correct order to build an increasingly powerful chain multiplier.
Every run features a randomly generated level, creating a fresh challenge each time. Players must combine quick reactions, precise timing, and concentration to avoid dangerous guards and keep from falling off the screen.
The Daily Challenge gives every player the same level and creates a fair competition for the best score. Optional local and global leaderboards allow players to compare their records with others.
